repairs.description: White argues that Crossan’s dating and source ordering depend on layered, presupposition-laden reconstructions, so their conclusions cannot independently establish that Gospel traditions are inauthentic.
repairs.rationale: Restores the complete proposition-to-inference link while preserving White’s emphasis on hypothesis-laden source reconstruction and its limited evidential independence.

repairs.description: Crossan argues that Christianity preserves one Gospel through four canonical narrative versions, not a single uniform orthodox account whose historicity can be assessed as such.
repairs.rationale: Restores the complete claim that canonical plurality undermines treating the sources as one singular, uniform account for purposes of historical assessment.
